features:
📢 [This is the best Prison Life script you can get]
Elevate your gameplay with the ultimate RDA Prison X / Prison Life Trainer Menu — fully equipped with a modern, customizable UI, advanced movement tools, bypassed teleports, and next-gen visuals.

🎨 Fully Customizable UI
Custom Themes & Colors: Tweak UI colors, dynamic accents, and custom background images.

Save System: Save and load your favorite configurations instantly.

Update Log: Built-in menu changelog so you never miss new features.

⚡ Movement & Physics
Walkspeed & Jump Power: Adjustable speed and jump height multipliers.

NoClip: Fly through geometry and map walls seamlessly.

Click TP (Bypassed): Point-and-click teleportation with anticheat bypass.

Vehicle Click TP: Bring your vehicle directly to where you click.

🛡️ Protections & Combat
Respawn Godmode: Respawns you at your exact location when killed or switching teams (e.g., swapping to Police keeps your exact position).

AI Silent Aim: AI-driven combat targeting in the Weapon Hub.

👁️ Visuals / ESP
Next-Gen ESP: Skeleton ESP, Player Tracers, MiniMap ESP, Inventory Inspector, and line-of-sight tracking.

🌍 World & Server Tools
Bypassed Teleports: Teleport to all major map locations with Reset Teleport support.

Freecam: Detach your camera to spy on surrounding areas and players.

Get Player Engaged [BETA]: Auto-tracks, targets, and maintains active interaction with nearby players.
